name: writing-loop
description: An autonomous short-drama (竖屏短剧) writers' room in a folder. Nine agents plan, design, write, review, score, and market-watch scripts through ticket state; a North Star charter plus canonical structured story design/assets keep 60-100 episode serials coherent without duplicate Markdown mirrors. Runs on Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.

interface.longDescription: Nine agents (Showrunner, Story-Designer, Episode-Writer, Reviewer, Script-Doctor, Evaluator, Market-Watch, Reflect, Sweep) plan, design, write, review, and score vertical micro-drama (竖屏短剧) scripts through ticket state on a local file board. The North Star is the creative charter; story/outline.v1.json and story/assets.v1.json are the only reusable structure and story-fact sources. Studio renders these facts directly instead of maintaining duplicate Markdown mirrors. Supports autonomous novel-adaptation intake and original creation.
